subject: Conditional Panel seems to work, but doesn't change input

messages.author: 042cc2571d196324
messages.subject: Conditional Panel seems to work, but doesn't change input
parts:
conditionalPanel does exactly what I want in terms of providing options to the user, but doesn't actually change the input value.  Illustrated here by using a simple example from an RMarkdown document:

---
title: "test conditional"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---



```{r, echo=FALSE}


inputPanel(
  selectInput("group", label = "Group:",
              choices = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), selected = "A"),
   
  selectInput("sub", label = "sub:",
              choices = c("a", "b", "c")),


    conditionalPanel(condition = "input.sub == 'a'",
                   selectInput("sub2", label = "Sub2:",
                               choices = c("1", "2", "3"))),
    conditionalPanel(condition = "input.sub == 'b'",
                   selectInput("sub2", label = "Sub2:",
                               choices = c("4", "5", "6"))),
    conditionalPanel(condition = "input.sub == 'c'",
                   selectInput("sub2", label = "Sub2:",
                               choices = c("7", "8", "9")))
 
  )


renderText({paste("You have chosen", input$group, input$sub, input$sub2)})
```


sub2 only changes to options from sub 'a', even though the selection options switch to b or c as chosen? I'm guessing this has something to do with what's happening underneath and may need to be changed through assigning outputs and a renderUI argument. Any ideas?
